requirements.text: A room booking feature that allows students to view available rooms, select dates and times easily, filter by room capacity, and receive booking confirmations.
A book loan feature that includes a search function for checking book availability and a straightforward borrowing process that can be completed through a mobile interface.
An online return feature that allows students to check books back in via their mobile devices.
A reminder system for due dates to help students avoid late returns and fines.
An overall emphasis on simplifying and streamlining the user experience for both room bookings and book loans.
